verdict.rationale: Foreloop supports background automation: a locally run agent checks for approved tasks on a cadence and works them as they arrive, the CLI can be driven from cron, PRs get automatic product reviews, and agents propose tasks from feedback submissions. However, the autonomous execution depends on you running a third-party agent (Claude Code or Codex) in a checkout on your own machine, and nothing runs until a person approves each contract. Missing for 10: hosted background execution without your own running agent, a configurable automation or scheduling surface in Foreloop itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
